name: Iori
message: 「...So, since ancient times, this island nation of Japan has been ruled by Ikusabito blessed with spiritual power.」

name: Iori
message: 「It is said that they manifested Tenju through blades imbued with spiritual protection―spirit swords―and reigned over the people.」

name: Iori
message: 「In the year 1870, these Ikusabito split into East and West and began the Boshin War.」

name: Iori
message: 「The Western Army, which possessed countries that produced superior tamahagane like Satsuma, Hishu, Tosa, and Bishu, overwhelmed the Eastern Army with their formidable Ikusabito.」

name: Iori
message: 「Thus, they built the capital in Osaka and declared the establishment of the Empire of Japan. They completed the Meiji Restoration... or so it goes.」
A few students were already slumped over their desks.

name: Iori
message: 「...Hey, Ririmu.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ugh... Teacher, your lecture is like, super boring.」

name: Iori
message: 「No, class just started... Setsugekka, are you actually listening？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ah, yes.」

name: Iori
message: 「What year did the Boshin War take place？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Uhh, hmm... Alright, let's go with 2020！」

name: Iori
message: 「You just skipped like five era names and jumped to the future！」
It seems Setsugekka wasn't listening at all.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ugh... Why do I have to memorize such trivial stuff anyway~」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「We live in the present, you know！」

name: Iori
message: 「...Momiji, why don't you teach Setsugekka the importance of history.」

name: Momiji
message: 「It’s like talking to a brick wall, you know.」
She seems to mean that it's not even worth teaching...

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Besides, I don't care about some old-fashioned people like Ikusabito! A swordsman is only as good as their sword swing, right!」

name: Iori
message: 「Are you fine with failing your midterms？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ugh, ugh... Kei-chan, help me~！」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Do your best to memorize it.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Cold! Cold as ice! You can only say that because you're smart, Kei-chan~!」

name: Momiji
message: 「This doesn't even count as something worth memorizing.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Teacher! The two geniuses are bullying me!」
Right, I'm just going to let it be.

name: Iori
message: 「Alright Ririmu, try reading the next part. ...Wait, Ririmu？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「If I go like this, then do that... Yes, that's it！」

name: Iori
message: 「Ririmu, let’s stop doing mental training during class.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「But I mean, even if you cram all that knowledge in, doesn't everyone forget it the second the test is over？」

name: Iori
message: 「That's not true. A sense of history enriches your life.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hmm... I wonder if that’s really true.」
Ririmu looks at me with skeptical eyes.

name: Iori
message: 「Anyway, I’m giving you all a quiz on what I just taught at the end of class.」

name: Iori
message: 「Students who don’t get a passing grade will have to stay after school for extra study. Be prepared.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ehhh~！？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「No way~！」

name: Iori
message: 「Hahaha, this is more than I expected...」
Seeing the dismal results of the quiz, my face twitches.

name: Asahi
message: 「Teacher, how did I do？」

name: Iori
message: 「Momiji, Asahi, and Keisetsu almost got perfect scores. It’s great that you’re so talented.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Obviously.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Obviously.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Well, it is the first thing we’re learning, after all.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「U-um, Teacher... what about me and Ririmu？」
Setsugekka just barely missed the mark, and Ririmu failed by a landslide. I couldn't help but laugh.

name: Iori
message: 「You two... yeah, let's try a little harder, shall we?」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ugh, I didn't get it at all~」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I really did try, though!」

name: Iori
message: 「Setsugekka, didn't you study with Keisetsu？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「No way, no way, studying with someone who memorized the entire <d0055>Code of Law</d> back in elementary school is impossible」
Seriously? As expected of a candidate for the next head of the Kazamine Family.

name: Iori
message: 「Anyway, Setsugekka and Ririmu are officially in remedial lessons. Stay in the classroom after school.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ahaha, I knew it, I knew it.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ehh~, but I wanted to go to the mainland~！」

name: Iori
message: 「This is all so you can compete in the Martial Festival. I’ll be joining you for the remedial lessons, so let’s all give it our best！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Oh, so Iorin is going to give me one-on-one instruction？ If it’s that, then maybe I can do it~」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Indeed, when you put it that way, I feel like I might be getting a good deal？」
Oh, looks like they’ve got a bit of motivation now. That’s good, that’s good.

name: Asahi
message: 「Teacher, should I attend the remedial lessons as well？」

name: Iori
message: 「No, you’re fine, Asahi. Feel free to do whatever you want after school.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Is that so? That’s a shame……」
Asahi looked somewhat lonely.

name: Iori
message: 「Alright, now for the practical training we’ve all been waiting for！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Yay！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yeah! Time to go wild!」

name: Momiji
message: 「A bunch of brats making noise outdoors, huh.」
We all headed to the indoor training grounds.
Some people call it the Simulator Room or the Yorishiro Hall, but people are pretty casual about that sort of thing.
There’s a reason it’s called the Simulator Room—this training facility houses a simulator known as Yorishiro-kun.
The whole Takamura Class will likely be making great use of Yorishiro-kun from here on out.

name: Iori
message: 「Now, I want everyone to demonstrate their martial forms. Don’t hold back just because it’s practice.」

name: Iori
message: 「……Setsugekka, you remember the form, right？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ahahahaha, obviously！ I’ll make the teacher swoon with my brilliant dance！」

name: Asahi
message: 「What a coincidence. I’m quite confident in my martial arts performance as well. It will be me who keeps Iori-sensei’s passionate gaze all to myself.」

name: Iori
message: 「Asahi, you don’t have to compete with her, you know？」

name: Asahi
message: 「Ufufu, I just wish for Iori-sensei to be watching me, always.」

name: Asahi
message: 「In fact, I'd rather you not look at anyone besides me.」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, I can't do that, but I'll definitely be watching you.」
I can feel her enthusiasm, so let's call it good.

name: Momiji
message: 「Let's hurry up and start. This is a waste of time.」
They put some distance between each other and get ready. Sure enough, they all look dignified holding a sword.

name: Iori
message: 「First, etiquette. We'll start from the seated stance. Ready... begin！」
Sitting down for a bow, from drawing the sword to sheathing it. Everyone pulls it off without a hitch... Whoa, what a surprise.

name: Iori
message: 「Keisetsu, you can actually perform the kata properly too, huh.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Yes, I used to learn alongside Setsugekka when we were little.」
Keisetsu, performing the kata alongside everyone else. Her movements are graceful and beautiful, even compared to the Martial Arts Division students.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hup... haaah！」
Even Setsugekka, who I was worried about... seems to be doing fine so far. Just watching their kata gives you a glimpse of their talent.
It's said that all the fundamental techniques are packed into kata. Actual matches are still a long, long way off.

name: Iori
message: 「Looking good, everyone！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Whaaat, I totally got this！ Heheh, this is a piece of cake... Huh, which way comes next again？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Don't think. Just let your body move on its own. That's how you were taught, isn't it？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Oh, right！ No thinking, just mooooving！」
Setsugekka, smoothly resuming her demonstration.

name: Iori
message: 「Must've been tough drilling it into her muscle memory, huh？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Yes, we hired personal trainers to drill it into her. Though two of them did quit partway through.」

name: Iori
message: 「A-And why would that be...？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Hehe, people break easily when they don't feel any sense of reward, don't they?」
Apparently, teaching Setsugekka how to perform a demonstration was one seriously grueling job...
Next up, the standing sword-drawing kata.
There are several variations, and every one of them is important for ceremonial events. They're handling this without any issues too... hmm？

name: Iori
message: 「Hey, Ririmu, what was that just now？ You're supposed to bring that sweep to the right to a crisp stop.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Huh？ Doesn't it look way cooler like this, though？」

name: Iori
message: 「Throwing in weird ad-libs will cost you points. Kata is about demonstrating prescribed movements, you know.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「But this way's way slicker~！」
Ririmu twirled her sword once after the parry. This... was undoubtedly grounds for a point deduction.

name: Iori
message: 「But if you change the forms however you like, you'll lose sight of what's correct, won't you？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Hmm？ It doesn't matter what's 'correct' or not.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Everything I express belongs to me. It's like, this is my worldview！」

name: Iori
message: 「I see. So, this is what you'd call Ririmu's philosophy, then.」
I understand what Ririmu is saying... but I'm not sure what to do about it.

name: Momiji
message: 「...Asahi, do you understand what she's saying？」

name: Asahi
message: 「It is likely a form of self-intoxication. Ririmu-san simply fails to appreciate the beauty of formal structure.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Shut it, you Kijo！ Don't go acting all high and mighty when you don't even get how sick my worldview is！」

name: Asahi
message: 「The fact that you resort to such an all-purpose barbarian word as 'sick' tells me everything I need to know.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「What did you say?！」
Ririmu and Asahi started squabbling at each other. Sigh, what a pain.

name: Iori
message: 「Alright, let's keep this momentum going！ Next is the physical fitness test.」

name: Iori
message: 「Physical strength is the driving force for everything. From here on out, I'm having you all go for a run.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Ugh, running is such a drag...」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Really？ I actually kind of like running. When I just run like 'hyah!', I don't have to think about anything at all!」

name: Momiji
message: 「It must be nice being so easygoing, Setsugekka.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「...Hey, Muragaki-san.」

name: Iori
message: 「Hm? What is it, Keisetsu?」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Do I really have to run as well？」
Keisetsu asks with a look that suggests she truly hates the idea.

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, of course. Since you're a member of the Takamura Class too, you'll be going through the same menu as everyone else.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I heard that before, but still...」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Kei-chan, you see, has never really been good at running or jumping since she was little.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Setsugekka, don't say unnecessary things.」

name: Iori
message: 「Keisetsu, you're going to be the head of the Kazamine family and the leader of the Kazamine Group, right？ If you let a little thing like this break you, your subordinates will look down on you.」
I grin at her.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Hmm... fine. I’ll take you up on that.」
Good, good. It seems she’s on board.

name: Iori
message: 「Alright, let’s go. Ready, set, start！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yeah, let’s gooo！」
Setsugekka took off with tremendous speed.

name: Asahi
message: 「I’m off.」
Asahi, Ririmu, and Keisetsu followed after her.

name: Momiji
message: 「One, two... one, two...」

name: Iori
message: 「...Momiji, at that rate, you’re basically just walking.」
And so, Momiji trailed behind everyone else at a snail’s pace.
Before long, the gap between them began to show clearly.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Huff, huff... ugh...！」

name: Iori
message: 「Keisetsu, don’t push yourself. It’s fine to take a break if you feel like you can’t go on.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I-I’m fine! If I give up over something like this, my subordinates will look down on me...」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Besides, hah... if the gap between me and Setsugekka gets too big, it’ll cause all sorts of problems for our relationship later on...」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Yoo-hoo! Hang in there, Kei-chan, you’re a whole lap behind!」
Setsugekka overtook her in the blink of an eye.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「G-gh... ugh... I can’t... any more.」
Seeing that, Keisetsu collapsed to the ground with a thud.

name: Iori
message: 「Hahaha, you did your best.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Ugh, so frustrating...！」
Heaven gives not two gifts, they say. I suppose everyone has their strengths and weaknesses.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I suppose I can’t beat someone who exercises every day. It’s pathetic of me, especially when I’m aiming to be the next family head...」

name: Iori
message: 「Do you think so? I don’t think it’s pathetic.」

name: Iori
message: 「You have plenty of exceptional talent, yet you never neglect your effort. I like that about you, Keisetsu.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「H-hmpf... it’s meaningless for me to be liked by you.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I want to be liked by those who follow me. Anything else isn’t worth considering.」

name: Iori
message: 「Well, in any case, I think showing a little bit of weakness makes it easier for the people under you to feel a sense of camaraderie.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「...And you think people feel camaraderie toward a figure who drops out faster than anyone else, crawling on the ground all by himself？」

name: Iori
message: 「Pfft, ahahaha... well, I suppose that’s true.」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「D-don’t laugh, geez!」
Puffing up her cheeks, Keisetsu turned away.

name: Iori
message: 「Alright, everyone, that’s a wrap！」
At the signal, they stopped running and gathered around.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Haa, haa... w-who came in first！？」

name: Iori
message: 「The results are... oh, Asahi is in the lead by a landslide. That’s amazing, Asahi！」
Asahi hadn't slowed her pace at all, even toward the end. Consequently, she had racked up more laps than anyone else.

name: Asahi
message: 「Hehe, thank you very much♪」

name: Asahi
message: 「I always make an effort to be prepared, both physically and mentally, in case any unforeseen circumstances arise with Iori-sensei.」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, do your best for Jindou, okay？」
Excluding Asahi, Momiji and Setsugekka were almost tied, with just a one-lap difference. Ririmu trailed slightly behind them.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「A-amazing~ Asahi-chan. I actually had quite a bit of confidence too.」

name: Asahi
message: 「The Mental Resonance Coefficient is innate and can’t be improved later, but anyone can improve their physical ability to some extent.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Setsugekka-san, if you want to beat Momiji-san, you should try to surpass her in at least a few points.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「I like that! I’ll take down Momimomi with raw strength!」

name: Momiji
message: 「And how exactly are you going to do that？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Like, pinning her down and then... heh heh heh.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Listen, the Martial Festival allows strikes and throws, but grappling and chokes are considered fouls, you know？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Then I’ll just tackle her when it’s not a match.」

name: Momiji
message: 「...Sensei. I think I’m about to be assaulted by Setsugekka-san.」

name: Iori
message: 「Setsugekka, make sure you maintain a sense of moderation when you pin her down.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Oka~y!」

name: Momiji
message: 「In the first place, you shouldn’t be pinning anyone down!」

name: Iori
message: 「All right, next let's measure your physical strength and Mental Resonance Coefficient.」
As a swordsman who uses Origami, both values are extremely important. I definitely want to check them beforehand.

name: Keisetsu
message: 「I don't have to do it, right？」

name: Iori
message: 「Yeah, that's right. Keisetsu can sit this one out.」
First, I hand Ririmu the Origami-type measuring device. It’s an excellent tool that can measure physical strength and the mental resonance value simultaneously.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Alrighty, let's do this... Hah！」
When she swings the Origami, the values appear automatically.

name: Iori
message: 「Physical strength is 60, mental resonance value is 90, huh. Not bad.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Heh, surprisingly impressive, right?」

name: Momiji
message: 「Seems average, maybe middle of the pack？」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Ehh, that’s the most unsatisfying type of assessment！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Then, I shall go next.」
Asahi grips the Origami and takes a Seigan stance.

name: Asahi
message: 「Haaah…！！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Whoa！? The sound was totally different just now！」

name: Iori
message: 「Physical strength is 117, mental resonance value is 78, I’d say. Your physicals are well above the average.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Whoa, what a display of colossal strength for someone who looks like that.」

name: Asahi
message: 「Ufufu, it’s embarrassing when you put it that way.」

name: Iori
message: 「Asahi is already easily exceeding the average level for active Jindou athletes. Everyone, you’d better not make Asahi angry.」

name: Asahi
message: 「It’s alright, I don't get angry over trifles, you know.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「That has absolutely zero credibility！」

name: Iori
message: 「Well, next is Momiji.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Yeah, yeah.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Whew, something like this, I guess.」

name: Iori
message: 「Physical strength is 77, mental resonance value is... oh, 113. Momiji, your mental resonance value is fantastic！」
This mental resonance value is likely top-tier among the first-year students at the academy. It means her power with Tenju is that much stronger.

name: Asahi
message: 「……That’s unfair.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Alrighty, I’m last！」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Here I go～……hyaah！！」

name: Iori
message: 「Physical strength is 85, mental resonance value is……hmm, 69？ That’s quite a bit lower than I expected. Is the machine malfunctioning……？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Hmm…… I think that number is probably right. It was around that much when I measured it before, too.」
It seems Setsugekka’s mental resonance value is quite low.

name: Ririmu
message: 「So that makes Momitchi number one and me number two？ Yay～, isn't that pretty awesome！？」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「No fair, no fair！ I want as much as Ririmu-chan too！ Sensei, I want that！」

name: Iori
message: 「You pestering me about it doesn't really help……」

name: Asahi
message: 「……Am I third?」
The mental resonance values in descending order are Momiji, Ririmu, Asahi, and Setsugekka. Asahi is slightly below average, and as for Setsugekka, the number is quite severe.
However, Setsugekka has her berserk state.
I’d really like to know her mental resonance value while she’s in a berserk state, but I wonder if it’s even possible to measure it properly in that condition…….
It seems necessary to learn more about her berserk state to figure out the best training plan for Setsugekka.

name: Iori
message: 「Setsugekka and Keisetsu, I need to talk to you two after the remedial lesson. Please stay behind for a bit.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ughhh, there’s something else even after the remedial lesson……？」

name: Keisetsu
message: 「Yes, I understand.」

name: Iori
message: 「Alright everyone, let’s head back to the classroom.」
Now that I have everyone’s basic data, I’ll use this to decide on the training plan for each of them.
